proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C hABC h
  have hs := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_add_angle_eq_pi C (ne₁₂_of_not_collinear hABC).symm
  have p1 : 0 < EuclideanGeometry.angle B C A :=
    EuclideanGeometry.angle_pos_of_not_collinear (by rwa [show ({B, C, A} : Set P) = {A, B, C} by ext x; simp; tauto])
  have p2 : 0 < EuclideanGeometry.angle C A B :=
    EuclideanGeometry.angle_pos_of_not_collinear (by rwa [show ({C, A, B} : Set P) = {A, B, C} by ext x; simp; tauto])
  constructor <;> linarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C : P), ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set P) → Real.pi / 2 ≤ EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C → EuclideanGeometry.angle B C A < Real.pi / 2 ∧ EuclideanGeometry.angle C A B < Real.pi / 2
